brief: Holds the target shape of a domain model, so the gap between it and a knowledgebase says which question to ask next.
detail: A goal is a pure specification and reads no global world: Gaps(oKB) is given the knowledgebase and answers what is missing in that one graph. RequireEach demands a relation of every entity of a type, RequireOne of one named subject. The graph is deliberately not stored, because a stored object is copied and would go stale. Build it with new stzGoal() or StzGoalQ().
